_note: Current-care needs for the BloomPetz daily loop.

rules: Each completed daily action costs 12.5 food/energy points (1/8 of a full pool).
At 0 food/energy, developmental actions are blocked until the pet is fed.
A full meal restores the pool to 100 when the pet has actually spent enough of the previous meal.
The stomach does not reset at midnight; remaining food/energy carries across calendar days.
Extra feeding while still full does not grant additional growth or stack food beyond 100.
Treats do not replace the daily meal.
Each accepted treat can apply randomized developmental stat micro-growth using the same weighted stat system as actions.
Treat number 4 and beyond are refused until the next daily reset.
Treat counters reset at midnight local device time.
